newsitem.title: UK: UK's Labour stretches lead to 21 points - paper.
newsitem.headline: UK's Labour stretches lead to 21 points - paper.

text.p: Britain's opposition Labour Party has stretched its lead over the Conservative Party to 21 points, an increase of five, according to the latest Gallup rolling poll in The Daily Telegraph newspaper on Wednesday.

"The latest survey shows Labour enjoying the backing of 51 percent of the electorate, up three points, the Conservatives on 30 percent, down two points, and the Lib Dems (Liberal Democrats) unchanged at 12 percent," the newspaper said in a statement.
The Gallup poll for the May 1 election is based on interviews with 1,129 electors on Sunday, Monday and Tuesday.
Support for The Referendum Party is at four percent with the other minority parties on three percent. -- London newsroom + 44 171 5427947
